additional_fill_asset.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: ONE isolated neutral tintable progress gauge FILL sprite for Unity UI, not a complete progress bar. Input image 1 is only a shape reference for the track's interior: create a separate white insert which fits INSIDE that very long thin horizontal track. The fill silhouette has width:height approximately 19:1, perfectly horizontal, straight top and bottom edges, symmetric small angled beveled end caps at left and right (each slant only about 0.35 times bar height, corresponding to 5 px when displayed at 14 px tall). Center the entire thin bar on a landscape transparent canvas with all ends visible. Solid almost-white ivory (RGB channels all near 245-255), almost flat neutral material with an extremely restrained smooth vertical brightness gradient, brightest slightly above center. Smooth high-resolution anti-aliased edges, NOT pixel art. IMPORTANT: the FILL ONLY. NO frame, NO dark outline, NO gold outline, NO inset line, NO repeated notches, NO segments, NO ornaments, NO text, NO glows, NO shadows, NO background, NO transparency inside the shape. Entire interior must be opaque white, exterior must be true alpha transparency. The engine will later multiply this neutral white sprite by crimson or gold using Image.color. Do not bake red or gold color into this asset. Do not reproduce the black and gold reference frame.
